review_limits: This audit can identify hidden prerequisites and avoidable instructional barriers. It cannot establish comprehension, durability, transfer, or production approval without observation of unfamiliar adult learners.

records.finding: No blocking hidden prerequisite found. The lesson starts with physical sharing, distinguishes group size from group count, and verifies the result by rebuilding the total.
records.residual_risk: Learners may still overgeneralize shared-equally division to every division situation.

records.finding: No blocking hidden prerequisite found. The whole and equal parts are established before numerator and denominator vocabulary, including values beyond one.
records.residual_risk: The spoken and written connection for fractions greater than one still requires human observation.

records.finding: Blocking prerequisite found: calculation screens relied on simplifying fractions and fraction multiplication even though neither skill was declared or taught.
records.residual_risk: The hundred-grid and the word rate may still add cognitive load on small screens or for first-time learners.

records.finding: No blocking hidden prerequisite found. Coverage and square units precede the rectangular multiplication rule, which is rebuilt from repeated rows.
records.residual_risk: Learners may still repeat length times width without understanding why it counts square units.

records.finding: No blocking hidden prerequisite found. A complete boundary trace precedes formulas and includes a non-rectangular path.
records.residual_risk: A static stepped path may not reveal whether learners independently track every segment.

records.finding: No blocking hidden prerequisite found. The boundary and nearby values are tested before the number line and greater-than-or-equal-to symbol.
records.residual_risk: Learners may memorize rightward direction without reconstructing the allowed set from context.

records.finding: No blocking hidden prerequisite found. The boundary and nearby values are tested before the number line and less-than-or-equal-to symbol.
records.residual_risk: Learners may substitute the word maximum without understanding why smaller values remain allowed.
